searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Search queries to search and merge results in one run

postalCode.title: Postal code
postalCode.description: Postal code of area where to search.

distance.title: Price to
distance.description: The size of the circle in which to look.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Approximate number of how many ads you want to load.

extractPhoneNumbers.title: Extract phone numbers
extractPhoneNumbers.description: Enable phone number extraction from ads. Requires Bazos cookies (bid and bkod).

bid.title: Bazos User ID (bid)
bid.description: Manual cookie: Bazos user ID (8-digit number). Required when 'Extract phone numbers' is enabled. Get it from browser console using the script in README.

bkod.title: Bazos Auth Token (bkod)
bkod.description: Manual cookie: Authentication token (10-char alphanumeric). Required when 'Extract phone numbers' is enabled. Get it from browser console using the script in README.

testCookiesBeforeRun.title: Test cookies before run
testCookiesBeforeRun.description: Test cookies validity before starting the scraper (recommended when extracting phone numbers)
